description: Fraction of candidate SMILES passing Lipinski Ro5 + Veber + ring-count >= 1 strict gate (lower is harder to pass)
scope: Lambda MCTS candidate pool (10 hand-picked curated SMILES spanning drug-like, cisplatin, acyclic PAINS, ion pairs)

aggregate.gap: within or above target; honest framing: this is 10 hand-picked curated SMILES, not a generated pool

pipeline_role: Pre-docking quality gate (cheap, RDKit-only, ~10 ms for 1000 mol). Drops acyclic PAINS (e.g. n-hexadecane) and ring-free ion pairs (e.g. [OH-].[Cu+2]).
verdict: MEASURED — pharmacophore_pass_rate=0.7 on 10 curated SMILES (7 strict pass, 9 lenient pass). The 3 fails are n-hexadecane (acyclic), [OH-].[Cu+2] (no rings + metal-only), and 1 borderline. Honest: this is on the curated smoke set, not a real generated pool, so the rate is biased upward; production measurement pending.
